title: Zephyr: MRHOF objective function
notes: Implemented RFC 6719/RFC 6550 MRHOF admission and selection hardening in Zephyr DODAG: reject zero-MHRI, below-root/same-DAGRank/saturated/looping candidates; MaxRankIncrease=0 disables the bound; remove cached inadmissible parents and re-prune after rank improvement; deterministic IPv6-address tie break; switch at exact hysteresis threshold; wrapped stale-parent deadline is fresh at equality and expires after it. Preserved fixed-point ETX and LICHEN load_factor cost. Validation: host C rpl_dodag 20/20 under UBSan (ctest 1/1); cppcheck warning/performance/portability clean; git diff --check clean; Rust lichen-rpl dodag 46/46; Python RPL + CCP MRHOF parity 62/62.
close_reason: Implemented and validated Zephyr MRHOF objective function behavior
